##### Product Registration - Air Music Tech

##### 1 / How do I install my new software?

1. You should have received a zip file download for MAC or PC. Please unzip the file for the Operating System you are currently using.
2. These installers offer a free 14 day built-in Demo. Once activated you will be prompted to enter a serial key. Please enter the serial key provided by ADSR in this section.
   If you have any problems with your downloaded files or an issue inserting your license/serial please contact InMusicBrands Software here:
   softwaresales@inmusicbrands.com
